# Page inventory

**Generated by `node scripts/page-inventory.js` from the pages themselves. Never edit it by hand.**
`node scripts/docs-check.js` fails when it is behind the pages, and the pre-commit hook
regenerates it. Why it exists: [LESSONS.md](LESSONS.md), "Page transitions".

Shared chrome on every page, left out of the rows: `controls.js`, `account.js`, `toast.js`, `walkers.js`, and the
token sheets `fonts.css`, `palette.css`, `themes.css`, `skin.css` (`chrome.css` imports them). A row says so when a page lacks one.
